claim.excerpt: In addition to these standard analyses, fentanyl concentrations in blood were quantified by means of a specific validated ultra-performance liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS/MS) method (Waters Corporation) to measure fentanyl, sufentanil, cefazolin, doxapram and keto-doxapram.

sources.title: Case report on postmortem fentanyl measurement after overdose with more than 67 fentanyl patches

why_it_matters: Links the substance to an analytical technique; does not imply a validated method for any laboratory.
